stories.explanation: Nombre de membres cité par la direction lors de la journée investisseurs.
stories.story_fr: Centene annonce servir plus de 28 millions de membres, dont beaucoup parmi les populations les plus complexes sur le plan médical.
stories.story_en: Centene says it serves more than 28 million members.
stories.citation: Centene is a mission-driven organization, dedicated to delivering high quality outcomes for more than 28 million members, many of whom are among the nation's most medically complex and historically underserved populations.
